title: Interim ledger: provisional credit queue + security-questionnaire hold flow for enterprise metering anomalies
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Enterprise customers occasionally trigger mid-cycle billing anomalies: delayed meter ingestion, duplicate meter events from proxy failover, and security-questionnaire holds that prevent invoice finalization. Current manual workflows create friction (manual credits, back-office spreadsheets, ad-hoc refunds) and increase time-to-resolution. This ticket designs and implements a provisional credit ledger entry and a Manual Review Queue (MRQ) gated by security-questionnaire/contract holds. The goal is to automate safe provisional credits below configurable thresholds, surface high-dollar events for finance/agreements review, and ensure idempotent reconciliation downstream so customers do not receive duplicate corrections.
acceptance_criteria: Provisional credit ledger implemented: provisional credits create a time-bound ledger entry (TTL configurable, default 30 days) that does not finalize to invoice until reconciliation completes.

Automated rules apply provisional credits for anomalies with clear heuristics: duplicate meter events within 5 minutes, negative delta after reconciliation, or ingestion lag > 24h, with thresholds per-customer tier.
Manual Review Queue exists in Console: finance/CS reps can filter by account, amount, reason code, and approve/reject with one-click actions and audit trail entries.

Security-questionnaire holds (SQH) prevent invoice finalization: when an SQH is present, provisional credits are visible but invoices remain in 'Pending Hold' and billing notifications include hold reason and recovery steps.

Idempotent reconciliation job: once upstream ingestion corrects meters, the reconciliation job consumes provisional entries and either converts to final credit on next invoice or voids provisional entry if duplicate; duplicates must not create additional customer credits.
End-to-end test coverage: unit tests for rules, integration tests for MRQ actions, and an end-to-end staging replay with recorded anomalous streams to validate ledger outcomes.

Operational metrics and alerts: reconciliations-per-hour, provisional-credit-rate, MRQ queue length, median time-to-approve, and anomaly false-positive rate (target < 5%) exposed in Console dashboard.
Finance sign-off and updated runbook: CFO/Revenue Ops approved UX and 2-step approval thresholds for credits > $10k. Runbook published in Confluence with post-mortem and escalation path.
implementation_plan: Design phase: finalize heuristics with Applied ML/Telemetry team (2 sprints). Deliverable: heuristics matrix and sample data coverage.

Ledger changes: create provisional_credit object on ledger with status {pending, approved, voided, finalized}, TTL and reason_code fields. Ensure backward-compatible schema migration (DB feature flag).
MRQ UI: Console screen for Manual Review Queue with filters, bulk actions, and per-item audit timeline. Connect MRQ actions to backend APIs that change ledger entry state.
Security hold integration: hook into existing security-questionnaire state machine so SQH toggles invoice_finalize_allowed flag per org. Ensure hold reasons flow into billing emails.
Reconciliation worker: idempotent consumer that ingests corrected meter stream and reconciles provisional entries to final credits or voids. Support dry-run mode for first 2 weeks.
Notifications & customer comms: templated billing-notice for provisional credit and hold status. Legal/Comm review before sending customers any automated refunds language.
Staging rollout: enable feature-flagged provisional credits for 5 pilot customers across industries, monitor metrics, collect feedback, iterate.
GA rollout: enable by default for enterprise orgs, update billing docs, and train finance/CS teams on MRQ and runbook.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (canary): internal billing team only — 1 week dry-run; dry-run mode records ledger actions but does not affect invoices.
Phase 1 (pilot): opt-in for 5 enterprise customers with existing reserved capacity or open contracts — 2 weeks; enable notifications to account owners.
Phase 2 (wider opt-in): enable for all enterprise customers behind feature flag; open MRQ to finance team — 4 weeks.
Phase 3 (GA): default-on for enterprise with opt-out via contract dialogue; update legal templates and public billing docs.
metrics: False positive rate of automated provisional credits (%)
Number of invoices blocked by SQH per month
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-issuing provisional credits leading to revenue leakage. Mitigation: conservative default thresholds, 2-step approval for > $10k, dry-run period and financial reconciliation checks.
Risk: Customers confused by provisional credits on billing portal. Mitigation: clear UI labels, separate provisional section, and customer-facing help article + templated comms.
Risk: SQH integration accidentally blocks legitimate invoices. Mitigation: add explicit owner/expiration on holds and emergency override for legal/finance with audit trail.

Risk: Reconciliation job misapplies corrections due to race conditions. Mitigation: strong idempotency keys, event ordering guarantees in worker, and reconciliation dry-run with manual verification for pilot customers.
